Three suppliers have an indexed price cap clause (Clause 6: "Unit prices are subject to an indexed price cap, adjusted annually by the consumer price index and capped at four percent"):

1. **Acme Components** — docs/suppliers/supplier-agreement-acme.docx
2. **Borealis Metals** — docs/suppliers/supplier-agreement-borealis.docx
3. **Corvid Plastics** — docs/suppliers/supplier-agreement-corvid.docx

All other supplier agreements checked (e.g., supplier-agreement-005 through 120, and supplier-agreement-dunmore.docx) instead state that unit prices are fixed for the term and are not indexed.
